mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(collect_time, '%H:00') AS time, COALESCE(SUM(energy_value), 0) AS value FROM energy_collect WHERE deleted = 0 AND collect_time >= #{start} AND collect_time <= #{end} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(collect_time, '%H:00') ORDER BY time ASC

SELECT CASE WHEN HOUR(collect_time) BETWEEN 8 AND 10 THEN '早高峰' WHEN HOUR(collect_time) BETWEEN 12 AND 14 THEN '午间' END AS time, COALESCE(SUM(energy_value), 0) AS value FROM energy_collect WHERE deleted = 0 AND HOUR(collect_time) IN (8,9,10,12,13,14) AND collect_time >= #{start} AND collect_time <= #{end} GROUP BY CASE WHEN HOUR(collect_time) BETWEEN 8 AND 10 THEN '早高峰' WHEN HOUR(collect_time) BETWEEN 12 AND 14 THEN '午间' END ORDER BY FIELD(time, '早高峰', '午间')
